create_tagdesc_instance: create a TagDesc instance to generate random adjective tags like bright or round for a template node
generate_tag_description: generate a tag description string from a TagDesc instance using the generate_description method
create_tagname_instance: create a TagName instance to generate random tag names like big spider or red box
generate_tagname_description: generate a tag name description with article prefix from a TagName instance using generate_description
review_tag_map: review the tag_map dictionary that maps colour, size, and tag keys to their adjective lists
